class.name: GameplayAbilityActivation
class.brief_description: Context and completion handle for one ability activation.
class.description: A [GameplayAbility] receives this handle in its script callbacks. Use it to read the granting component, actor, level, and saved default tag fields captured by the grant. Keep this handle while a run waits for a timer or another event. Call [method end] to finish this exact run.

method.name: end
method.description: Finishes the active run normally and calls the end callback with [code]canceled = false[/code]. Returns [code]OK[/code] when finished or an error if this activation is stale or unavailable.

method.name: get_actor
method.description: Returns the live actor, captured from the component's immediate parent when the attempt began. Returns [code]null[/code] when the actor is unavailable.

method.name: get_component
method.description: Returns the granting component, or [code]null[/code] when it is unavailable.

method.name: get_default_tags
method.description: Returns a detached copy of the tags in [param field] as captured when this ability was granted. A valid unset field returns an empty container. An unrecognized field returns [code]null[/code]. The captured defaults remain readable after the activation ends.

method.name: get_level
method.description: Returns the level of the grant used for this attempt.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether this activation is currently running. A timer or signal callback can check this before completing a run.
